info.title: Stash Studio API
info.description:
APIs for querying a shop's managed product catalog and loyalty program, and for configuring the loyalty program from a partner's own tools. Designed for server-to-server communication between partner backends and Stash services.

## Base URLs

| Environment | Base URL |
|---|---|
| **Test** | `https://test-api.stash.gg` |
| **Production** | `https://api.stash.gg` |

All endpoint paths below are relative to the base URL. For example, to list products in the test environment:

```
GET https://test-api.stash.gg/sdk/studio/{shop_id}/products
```

## Authentication

Every request is signed with your Ingress API key (HMAC-SHA256). Send the signature in the versioned `x-stash-hmac-signature` header.

### Setup

1. Go to **Stash Studio > Project Settings > API Secrets**
2. Click **Generate Secret** to create a new key
3. Keys created through this portal are Ingress keys by default and work with this API (this is the same key used for `/sdk/` API authentication)
4. Store the secret securely; you will need it to sign every request

### Signing a Request

1. Take the current time as a Unix timestamp in **milliseconds**, for example `1790000000000`
2. Build the string to sign as `{timestamp}.{body}`. For GET requests `{body}` is empty. For PUT requests it is the **request body exactly as you send it** (the same bytes; do not re-serialize the JSON after signing)
3. Compute HMAC-SHA256 of that string with your API secret and Base64-encode the result
4. Send the header `x-stash-hmac-signature: v1;{shopId};{timestamp};{base64Signature}`. The timestamp must be within 5 minutes of Stash server time

### Example (curl)

```bash
TS=$(($(date +%s) * 1000))
BODY=""   # for PUT, the exact JSON you will send, e.g. BODY='{"activate":true}'
SIGNATURE=$(printf '%s' "${TS}.${BODY}" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "YOUR_API_SECRET" -binary | base64)
curl -H "x-stash-hmac-signature: v1;{shop_id};${TS};${SIGNATURE}" \
  "https://test-api.stash.gg/sdk/studio/{shop_id}/products"
```

### Legacy header (deprecated)

`stash-hmac-signature` carries an untimestamped Base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the body alone (empty string for GET). It is still accepted but is replayable; use the versioned header for new integrations and for every configuration write.

put.description: Creates or updates one loyalty campaign (season) together with the shop-level display settings, bonus definitions and reward products it depends on, and optionally activates the program. The campaign id is the upsert key: an existing id updates that season, a new id creates one. The request describes the whole season it names, so a tier or milestone omitted from it is removed from that season; bonuses and reward products are created or updated by id or SKU and never removed. Draft and scheduled seasons accept every change. An active season accepts names, descriptions, images, milestone rewards, tier earn rates and a new end date; thresholds, adding or removing tiers or milestones, the start date and reset rules are refused with FAILED_PRECONDITION listing the fields. Ended seasons are read-only. The request body must be signed exactly as sent. Applying is idempotent: after a 500, resend the same request. Returns INVALID_ARGUMENT with per-field violations when validation fails, PERMISSION_DENIED when the shop is not enabled for configuration writes, ABORTED when another update for the shop is in progress, and NOT_FOUND for an unknown shop.

hmac.description: Versioned HMAC-SHA256 signature for server-to-server requests to this API (your backend calling Stash), as opposed to client-side operations. Recommended over the deprecated legacyHmac scheme for the best security. Header format: v1;{shopId};{unixMillisTimestamp};{base64Signature} (semicolon-delimited). {base64Signature} is the base64-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of the string {unixMillisTimestamp}.{requestBody} signed with your Ingress API key, where {requestBody} is the request JSON exactly as sent for POST and PUT requests and empty for GET requests. The timestamp must be within 5 minutes of Stash server time. Your shopId is your immutable shop identifier; it and your Ingress API key are available in Stash Studio under Project Settings > API Secrets.
hmac.name: x-stash-hmac-signature
